visual.general_description: Line chart of lead whole blood concentration in μg/L over eleven printed dates, with colored background bands and two small icon drawings.
visual.detailed_description: A smooth cyan line with round markers on a white background with light horizontal gridlines. The y-axis is labelled "Lead whole blood concentration (μg/L)" with ticks 0, 50, 100, 150 and 200. The x-axis shows rotated date labels 10/19/2018, 01/27/2021, 08/02/2021, 01/19/2022, 04/26/2022, 06/17/2022, 12/09/2022, 03/13/2023, 07/12/2023, 01/31/2024 and 07/17/2024. Printed numbers beside markers are 72, 83, 170, 198, 98, 67, 51, 43, 41 and 40; the marker at 04/26/2022 has no printed number. The line starts at 72, rises through 83, 170 and 198 to a rounded peak near the 200 gridline around 04/26/2022, then falls through 98, 67 and 51 and flattens at 43, 41 and 40. Background bands: a blue-gray band from the 01/27/2021 tick to the 01/19/2022 tick reaching the 200 line, a red band from the 04/26/2022 tick to the 06/17/2022 tick reaching the 200 line, a yellow band from the 06/17/2022 tick to the 03/13/2023 tick reaching the 100 line, and a light gray band from the 03/13/2023 tick to the 07/17/2024 tick reaching the 50 line. An arrow labelled "resumption of use" points to the marker at 01/27/2021 and an arrow labelled "stop use" points to the marker at 04/26/2022. A drawing of an eye with a brush and a small bottle sits at the upper left, and a similar drawing with a red STOP sign sits in the lower middle. No patient name, date of birth or other identifying text is visible.
